items.name: diagnosing-bugs
items.author: Matt Pocock
items.when: Something is broken, throwing, failing, or slow — a hard bug
items.why: Build a tight feedback loop first, then localize, reduce, fix, and guard.

items.name: premortem
items.author: GeorgeT
items.when: A change that touches data, money, jobs, or what a person sees
items.why: Name where it can break before you write. A small change gets a short answer.

items.name: grill-me
items.author: Matt Pocock
items.when: They asked to grill a plan or design, or the ask is underspecified
items.why: Interview until every branch of the design tree is resolved. Uses grilling.

items.name: grilling
items.author: Matt Pocock
items.when: Stress-testing a plan, decision, or idea
items.why: The interview primitive behind grill-me. Relentless questions until branches are closed.

items.name: design-reference-hunt
items.author: Long Beard
items.when: A page with no official look (no DESIGN.md, no Figma, no board), or they asked to hunt references
items.why: Ask once for a Figma file. No direction: look widely, then keep, and write `.design/board.md`. Scroll and screenshot only the keeps. Another business lends a layout or a component only, not its type or its colours, and only if it still fits this topic. Ask once which of the closest cards should lead, then write the cards and a short Read this. Before looking, ask once for a specific style and any requirements. On a piece (a loading state, a control), also offer two or three search ideas, then look after they answer. A later hunt (a view, a control, new ideas, a double-check) is a suggestion set in `.design/hunts/<slug>/`. It does not replace the board, `.design/refs/`, DESIGN.md, or a Figma file, and the whole look does not replace `.design/hunts/`.

items.name: design-taste-frontend
items.author: Leonxlnx
items.when: A page with no design yet
items.why: Do not deal this skill’s references, and do not run draw. No official look is hunt: wait for `.design/board.md`. Those cards are the references. Build from them. The control a card describes is the control. Do not add a filled button the card does not show. Inspect still.

items.name: animate
items.author: emilkowalski
items.when: They asked to animate a control or a transition
items.why: A page design-taste-frontend is building keeps that skill’s motion. Decide this one move, then build it.

items.name: jury
items.author: juliobsz
items.when: They asked to jury, score, judge, or roast the design (or a live URL / local build)
items.why: Blind evidence scorecard. Do not redesign. Fixes stay on the board, DESIGN.md, or Figma. Do not run after every Taste build unless they asked.

items.name: handoff
items.author: Matt Pocock

items.why: Compact the conversation into a handoff document another agent can pick up.

items.name: design-md
items.author: Long Beard
items.why: Follow DESIGN.md when it exists. A missing file plus “design this page” is hunt, not a question.
